contracts.name: Relief Server
contracts.benefit: Adds delivery, ordering, seating, and payment capacity.
contracts.downside: Payroll continues even when the kitchen is the bottleneck.

contracts.name: Busser
contracts.downside: Does not cook, deliver, take orders, or fix stockouts.

priorities.name: Balanced Service
priorities.benefit: Uses the normal dining-room task order.
priorities.downside: No single bottleneck receives special attention.

priorities.name: Run Ready Food
priorities.benefit: Keeps the oldest ready plate first.
priorities.downside: Turnover and guest recovery may wait.

priorities.name: Turn Tables
priorities.benefit: Moves dirty-table clearing ahead of other service work.
priorities.downside: Ready food and ordering may wait.

priorities.name: Guest Recovery
priorities.benefit: Moves greeting and payment work ahead of routine service.
